messages:
alex: kicked off a targeted nightly microprobe run for kernel selection — focusing on arch-aware picks and seqlen-dependent paths. wanted to capture KV-cache hit patterns and batching jitter across A100/H100. results & notes below.

perf-bot: nightly-run: microprobe/arch-aware/2024-11-12 started on pool:ci-gpu-large. configs: seeds=3, workload-mix=[chat,completion], seq_lens=[32,128,512,1024], batch_sizes=[1,4,8]. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/microprobe/1768459876/ (summary + raw).

kevin: initial flag: for seq_len=512 on A100, candidate kernel 'matmul-v3-int8' regressed ~12% p95 latency vs baseline matmul-v2-fp16. observed higher L2 thrash. attaching log snippet.

kevin: ```
# tail -n 50 /tmp/microprobe/1768459876/a100-seq512/log.txt
[2024-11-12T02:03:12Z] kernel matmul-v3-int8: throughput=8400 toks/s, p95=14.2ms
[2024-11-12T02:03:12Z] baseline matmul-v2-fp16: throughput=9600 toks/s, p95=12.7ms
NVML mem-bandwidth: 550 GB/s
L2-miss-rate: 0.018 -> 0.042
```

sara: thanks. can we repro with kv-cache warm vs cold? my hypothesis: int8 path lacks prefetch for KV scatter causing L2 spike when seqlen midrange (256-768).

yun: FYI I added a small patch to the harness to collect per-kernel load/store counters (pmu) and a simpler kv-access trace. launched re-run on A100 + H100.

perf-bot: re-run completed: artifacts at s3://redwood-perf/microprobe/1768459876/rerun-1. summary: A100: matmul-v3-int8 p95 regressed 11-13% at seq_len 512; H100: no regression, matmul-v3-int8 ~ parity with baseline.

kevin: interesting cross-arch delta. suggests kernel chosen by autotuner should be arch-aware (obv) but also seqlen-aware: fallback to fp16 on A100 for 256-768 range. we should encode a sequence-length policy table.

alex: agreed. propose short-term rule: if arch==A100 and seq_len in [256,768] prefer matmul-v2-fp16 unless memory pressure low. long-term: autotuner should collect L2/PMU signals and learn a gating function.

kevin: action items:
- yun: upload pmu traces + kv-access logs to the ticket.
- sara: run the same microprobe on aoc-1 (ROCm) to see AMD behavior.
- alex: add seqlen-policy to tunercfg and run smoke CI.

yun: started ROCm run. preliminary: ROCm shows matmul-v3-int8 slightly faster for seq=512 but with increased variance (p95 jumps on bursts). kv-cache behavior different: KV prefetch path missing on older ROCm drivers.

perf-bot: nightly-scan note: 6 candidate kernels evaluated, 2 flagged for arch-seqlen gating, 1 flagged for flaky p95 on ROCm. full matrix: A100/H100/ROCm x seq=[32,128,512,1024] x batch=[1,4,8].

alex: can we update the perf CI to fail PRs that introduce >8% p95 regression on stable kernel picks for any arch? current threshold is 10% which is too loose for latency SLOs. also add a column in CI matrix that records 'kv-cache-warm' vs 'cold' runs.

kevin: +1 on tightening threshold. but let's make it configurable per workload: chat vs completion have different sensitivity. set chat threshold=6% p95.

perf-bot: noted. created issue RW-Perf #432: "arch+seqlen autotune gating + kv-cache ci policies" with attached artifacts.

sara: quick question on harness: what's the exact command you used so I can replay locally?

alex: ```
./tools/microprobe/run.sh --suite arch-aware --model gpt-small --seqlens 32,128,512,1024 --batches 1,4,8 --reps 3 --collect=pmu,kvtrace --target-pools a100,h100,rocm-aoc
```

yun: note: when reproducing locally, set --gpu-lock to avoid noisy colocated jobs. also use --kv-warm=0/1 to toggle cache warm state.

kevin: follow-up: for immediate mitigation I patched the autotuner ruleset (staging) to insert:
```
if arch == A100 and 256 <= seq_len <= 768:
  prefer: matmul-v2-fp16
  reason: L2 thrash seen with int8 kernel
```
and kicked off the smoke CI.

deploy-bot: smoke-ci: runtest/arch-policy-staging started (PR #2147).

perf-bot: smoke-ci completed: no regressions vs baseline after rule applied. p95 differences now within 2-3% for the affected ranges on A100.

alex: ok nice. long-term plan:
- expand microprobe to include dynamic batching jitter (simulate bursty arrival)
- instrument autotuner to persist PMU-derived features per candidate kernel
- add per-arch seqlen heatmaps to the console (ops can pin policies)

sara: I'll draft a short runbook for oncall: how to read the microprobe artifacts and flip temporary gating rules.

yun: uploaded pmu traces + kv traces to RW-Perf #432. link in issue.

kevin: thumbs up. closing loop: will schedule a weekly nightly that focuses on 'midrange seqlen' because that's our recurring painpoint.

alex: thanks team. if anyone spots additional regressions from today's run drop them in RW-Perf #432 or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
